_about: Public-domain William Mackergo Taylor (1829-1895), Scottish-born Congregational minister of the Broadway Tabernacle, New York, for the Word Hoard: his Bible biographies (David, Elijah, Peter, Daniel, Moses, Paul, Joseph, Ruth and Esther), The Ministry of the Word (1876), The Gospel Miracles (1880), The Parables of our Saviour (1886), The Miracles of our Saviour (1890), The Scottish Pulpit (1887), John Knox (1885) and several volumes of sermons, 1865-1893. Texts are from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 62 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
